{{Quote|My friend Jed, his wife and both his daughters have come home. Tana Moss, too.|[[Danbar Hue]]|<ref name="TOR:SaR" />}}
The '''wife''' of [[Jed]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] and [[Parent/Legends|daughters]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang kidnapped the family, though [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-allied individuals sent by Jed's friend [[Danbar Hue]] rescued them and other captive [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] from the [[Twin Sun pirates base|pirate base]].<ref name="TOR:SaR" />
